target_intent: Keep every coherent plant structure, including exposed roots, stems, trunks, branches, leaves, flowers, and connected low vegetation. Remove only the assigned rigid non-plant object classes.
plant_prompt: complete living plants including exposed roots, woody stems, trunks, branches, leaves, flowers, shrubs, succulents, grasses and ferns

chain_barrier.prompt: black metal chain barrier, repeating metal chain links, rigid chain posts and bollards
chain_barrier.distractor_prompt: curved vines, thin living stems, exposed roots, branches, leaves and flowers

fence.prompt: rigid wire mesh fence, wooden slat fence, straight fence rails and evenly spaced fence posts
fence.distractor_prompt: woody trunks, branches, roots, curved stems, shrubs, leaves and flowers

living_wall_frame.prompt: rigid modular planting frame, metal wall panel, planter tray edges, straight irrigation pipe and structural supports
living_wall_frame.distractor_prompt: living wall plants, trailing roots, stems, vines, leaves, ferns, flowers and moss

railing.prompt: rigid metal railing, straight handrail, diagonal fence bars, evenly spaced vertical metal posts and metal top bar
railing.distractor_prompt: woody tree branches, curved stems, trunks, exposed roots, shrubs and leaves
